### Trump’s falling job approval rating among Latino registered voters

Today, 24% of Latino registered voters say they approve of Trump’s handling of his job as president. This number has fallen 14 percentage points from the start of his second term, when 38% approved of his job. [...] Two years into the second Trump administration, the president’s standing with Latino voters has deteriorated. His current job approval rating among Latino voters, at 24%, is down from 38% in February 2025. And majorities of Latino voters say the Trump administration’s policies harm Hispanics more than help them and that their situation as a group is worse than a year ago. results.content:
In this survey, just 38% of registered voters approved of the job President Trump is doing, with 61% disapproving (-23). Likely voters gave him a 40% to 59% rating (-19), still not very good, but even a slight margin can make a difference in how significant the gains either party might make in the election are.

That said, an equal share — 53% — of registered and likely voters said they "strongly disapprove" of the job Trump is doing, tied with last month as the highest ever in the poll.

## Trump Approval Rating at 40% Among Likely Voters

40% of likely voters approve of the job President Trump is doing in office, and 59% disapprove. Likely voters are more than twice as likely to strongly disapprove (53%) of President Trump’s job performance than to strongly approve (24%). The president’s approval rating notches down to 38% among registered voters nationally. Among this group, 61% disapprove.
